kids: Watch The Grinch on a big screen
Dance with the DJ before the movie
site: Tamarac Park on North University Drive
Sensory hour from 5:30 PM for guests who want a quieter start
about: Tamarac's city event page is titled Winter Wonderland and describes a cozy holiday movie night with The Grinch on a big screen.
The schedule has three parts: a sensory hour from 5:30 to 6:30 PM, pre-movie activities at 6:30 PM, and the movie at 8 PM.
The city lists a DJ, a bounce house, food trucks and a festive holiday train ride, and labels the evening a free family event.
The page is tagged Parks and Recreation and Special Events, and it lists adults, children and families among the audiences.
Other Tamarac holiday dates on the city's calendar include Santa's Community Ride and the holiday lighting on December 5, and Paws with Claus on December 12.
faq: Is the Tamarac Grinch movie night free?
Yes. The city labels Winter Wonderland a free family event.
What time does the movie start?
The movie begins at 8 PM on Friday, December 11, 2026. Pre-movie activities start at 6:30 PM.
Is there a sensory friendly option?
The city schedules a sensory hour from 5:30 to 6:30 PM.
What is there to do before the movie?
A DJ, a bounce house, food trucks and a holiday train ride, according to the city.
Where is it?
Tamarac Park, 7501 N University Dr, Tamarac, FL 33321.
Which movie is showing?
The Grinch.

kids: Meet Santa at the boat ramp before he sets sail
Wave from the waterfront as Santa cruises by
site: Waterfront homes and parks along the Island City route
about: Look out, Island City: the city bills Santa by Sea as one of Broward County's most unique holiday traditions, with Santa trading his sleigh for the sea.
Santa and his elves depart from the Colohatchee Park boat ramp and cruise the Island City waterways, spreading cheer to residents and visitors along the route.
Families can meet and greet Santa at the park before he sets sail, and residents who live on the water are encouraged to step outside and wave.
Boat owners who want to take part gather at the ramp 30 minutes before departure.
The special events page files the evening under Leisure Services and tags it with Christmas, Santa, children and kids.
A Holiday Concert at Mickel Park follows on December 18 at 7 PM on the same city calendar.
The Colohatchee Park boat ramp is on NE 15th Avenue, and the city invites families to come early to the park to meet and greet Santa before he sets sail.
faq: Is Santa by Sea free?
Yes. The city calendar lists the cost as free.
What time does Santa leave?
The listing gives 5:30 PM on Monday, December 14, 2026.
Where do we meet Santa?
At the Colohatchee Park boat ramp, 1975 NE 15th Ave, Wilton Manors.
Can my boat join in?
The city invites boat owners to join, and asks them to gather at the ramp 30 minutes before departure.
Can we watch from home?
Yes. The city asks waterfront residents to step outside and wave as Santa passes.
Who runs it?
The City of Wilton Manors.

kids: Take photos with Santa and The Grinch
site: Hagen Park Community Center on Wilton Drive
about: Leisure Services staff plan a festive morning of family fun, with Santa, The Grinch and their holiday friends as the guests of honor.
Activities on the city listing are storytime, arts and crafts, games, a petting zoo and a candy cane hunt.
The city's calendar lists the cost as free and says all ages are welcome, and suggests bringing a camera for photos with Santa and The Grinch.
The Wilton Manors Public Library, at 500 NE 26th St, also holds a drop-in Family Fun with Board Games session in its Children's Area on Saturdays from 11 AM to 1 PM, including December 19.
Wilton Wonderland ends at noon, while the library board game session runs from 11 AM to 1 PM, so the two overlap for the final hour.
The presenting department also runs the Holiday Lighting Ceremony on December 3 and Santa by Sea on December 14, so the three events make a set for families who want more than one outing.
The city labels the morning a festive celebration of the holiday season in Wilton Manors, and the listing notes that photos with Santa and The Grinch are part of the plan.

Art Gallery 21: The Winner's Show, a separate art exhibit, opens at the Island City Cultural Center at 5 PM that evening, and a staged outdoor play, Our Town, runs at Richardson Historic Park at 4 PM and 7 PM.
faq: Is Wilton Wonderland free?
Yes. The city lists the cost as free.
What time is it?
Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 10 AM to noon.
Who will be there?
Santa and The Grinch, along with their holiday friends.
What activities are planned?
Storytime, arts and crafts, games, a petting zoo and a candy cane hunt.
Where is it?
Hagen Park Community Center, 2020 Wilton Dr, Wilton Manors, FL 33305.
Are older kids welcome?
The city says all ages are welcome.
Which department hosts it?
The City of Wilton Manors Leisure Services Department.
Should I bring a camera?
The city suggests it, since photos with Santa and The Grinch are part of the morning.
Is there a petting zoo?
Yes. The city lists a petting zoo among the activities.

site: Flippen Park at NE 21st Ct and Wilton Dr
Food and local vendors on site
about: The annual ceremony is pitched as a way to kick off the holiday season with warmth, light and community spirit, and everyone in town is invited.
Three lightings happen together: the Holiday Menorah, the Kinara and the Wilton Manors Christmas tree.
The calendar entry lists live entertainment, food and local vendors, and family friendly holiday activities for all ages.
The city frames the evening as a celebration of the diversity and traditions of the season.
Santa by Sea follows on December 14 and Wilton Wonderland on December 19 on the same Leisure Services Special Events calendar.
The ceremony is the first of three city holiday events on the December calendar, ahead of a Holiday Concert at Mickel Park on December 18 at 7 PM.
Flippen Park is located at the corner of NE 21st Court and Wilton Drive in Wilton Manors, FL 33305.
The city's calendar for the same day also lists a Chair Yoga Empower Hour and Sound Therapy class at the Island City Cultural Center, 600 NE 21st Ct, at 10:30 AM.
The city website offers map links for the park and lets visitors create a website account to manage notification subscriptions and event reminders.
Admission is listed as free, and the calendar entry names food and local vendors, so any purchases there are optional.
faq: Is the Holiday Lighting Ceremony free?
Yes. The city calendar lists the cost as free.
What time does it start?
6:30 PM on Thursday, December 3, 2026.
What gets lit?
The Holiday Menorah, the Kinara and the Wilton Manors Christmas tree.
Is there food?
The city lists food and local vendors.
Where is it?
Flippen Park, NE 21st Ct and Wilton Dr, Wilton Manors, FL 33305.
Is it suitable for young children?
The city describes it as a festive celebration for all ages.
Does the ceremony include Hanukkah and Kwanzaa traditions?
Yes. The Holiday Menorah and the Kinara are lit alongside the Christmas tree.
Who organizes it?
The City of Wilton Manors, through its Leisure Services Special Events calendar.
Can I get reminders for city events?
The city website lets visitors create an account to manage notification subscriptions.
What else is on the city calendar this month?
Santa by Sea on December 14, a Holiday Concert at Mickel Park on December 18 and Wilton Wonderland on December 19.

kids: Join the town's holiday celebration downtown
about: The town's tourism site lists Christmas By-The-Sea on its events page for Wednesday, December 2, 2026 from 5 to 8 PM, and says the page covers free events open to the public.
A Vendor Village application for the 2026 event is posted on the same page, so craft and gift vendors set up for the evening.
The town reminds visitors that parking is available in the public lots and that Circuit-By-The-Sea provides rides for people who parked a few blocks away.
The Farmers' Market returns on Sunday, December 6 at El Prado Park, 4500 El Mar Drive, from 9 AM to 1 PM, and runs on Sundays through May 2, 2027.
The town's tourism office lists a phone number of 954-640-4200, and its Community Center is in Jarvis Hall at 4505 Ocean Drive.
faq: Is Christmas By-The-Sea free?
The town lists it among its free events open to the public.
What time is it?
Wednesday, December 2, 2026 from 5 to 8 PM.
Where is it held?
Downtown Lauderdale-By-The-Sea.
Where do I park?
In one of the town's public parking lots, or request a ride on Circuit-By-The-Sea if you park a few blocks away.
Are there vendors?
Yes. The town runs a Vendor Village and posts a vendor application.
Who runs it?
The Town of Lauderdale-By-The-Sea.
